name: 04_zero_quarters
description: Year-to-date method: a whole year of income below θ (four zero payments), then a year that crosses θ in Q3 (payments only for the increments); plus proof/attestation reverts (tampered public signal, wrong key type, disabled tier).

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: four zero reports: lastPaidPeriod 8107, nothing ever owed, vault 0, status OnTime
honest proof for 800, claimed payment 0 → public signal mismatch → proof fails
tier 2 needs a report-verifier key, not an attestor
first real payment in Q3 2027: 800 gross, 40 fee, 760 net
2027 total 2,400 = 4% × (140,000 − 80,000); each holder received 570 USDC net
